# South East Water

> South East Water serves 1.87 million people across southeast Australia with water, sewerage, recycled water services, and comprehensive billing and financial assistance programs.

South East Water is a major water utility provider offering account management, billing, payment options, financial assistance, and support services for residential and business customers. The site provides guides for managing accounts, moving house, applying for concessions, and accessing flexible payment plans and emergency relief grants.

## Key Topics

- mySouthEastWater portal
- Account management
- Billing and payments
- BPAY and direct debit
- Financial assistance
- Payment plans and Centrepay
- Concessions and discounts
- Utility Relief Grant Scheme
- Moving house
- Family violence support
- eBills
- Water meters
- Business accounts
- PropertyConnect
- Customer support

## Accounts and Billing

- [Accounts and billing](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing): Main accounts and billing hub for managing accounts, payments, and trade waste permits.
- [Manage your account](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/manage-account): Guide to managing your account online via mySouthEastWater portal anytime.
- [Register for mySouthEastWater](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/manage-account/mysoutheastwater-portal): Getting started guide for registering and using mySouthEastWater online portal.
- [Understanding your bill](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/manage-account/your-bill): Guide explaining bill components, charges, meter readings, and leak detection.
- [Pay your bill](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/manage-account/pay-your-bill): How-to guide for paying bills via credit card, direct debit, BPAY, or Australia Post.
- [Switch to eBills](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/manage-account/switch-to-ebills): Tutorial for switching from paper to email billing via mySouthEastWater portal.

## Financial Assistance and Support

- [Help and support](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/financial-assistance): Financial assistance hub with payment options, concessions, and family violence support.
- [Flexible payment options](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/financial-assistance/flexible-payment-options): Guide to flexible payment plans, extensions, and Centrepay options for bills.
- [Apply for a concession](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/financial-assistance/apply-for-a-concession): How-to apply for water and sewerage discounts with pension or concession cards.
- [Utility relief grant](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/financial-assistance/utility-relief-grant): Guide to Utility Relief Grant Scheme for low-income households in financial difficulty.
- [Family violence support](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/financial-assistance/support): Specialist family violence support team and utility relief grant resources.

## Moving House

- [Moving house](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/moving-house): Hub for moving house guides for renters, homeowners, and property professionals.
- [I'm a renter](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/moving-house/im-a-renter): Moving guide for renters with billing, setup, and concession card information.
- [I'm a homeowner](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/moving-house/im-a-home-owner): Guide for homeowners buying/selling property or managing tenant transitions.
- [I'm a rental provider or property manager](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/moving-house/rental-provider-or-property-manager): Moving house guide for rental providers and property managers handling tenant changes.
- [I'm a conveyancer or solicitor](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/moving-house/im-a-conveyancer-or-solicitor): Property settlement information for conveyancers using PropertyConnect and vendor statements.

## Business Services

- [Business](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/business): Business account hub for billing, payments, and water conservation programs.
- [Pay your business bill](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/business/pay-your-bill-business): Business billing payment guide with credit card, BPAY, and EFT payment methods.

## Optional

- [When someone passes away](https://southeastwater.com.au/accounts-and-billing/manage-account/when-someone-passes): Support guide for notifying South East Water when account holder passes away.
